```sql
WITH attendance_2023_cleaned AS (
  SELECT
    "Centre" AS centre_name,
    "Month" AS month,
    "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolment,
    "Avg Daily Present" AS average_attendance,
    CAST("Avg Daily Present" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF("Enrolled Kids", 0) * 100 AS attendance_pct
  FROM "attendance_2023"
),
attendance_2024_cleaned AS (
  SELECT
    "centre_name",
    "month",
    "enrolment",
    "average_attendance",
    CAST("average_attendance" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF("enrolment", 0) * 100 AS attendance_pct
  FROM "attendance_2024"
),
avg_2023 AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name,
    AVG(attendance_pct) AS avg_attendance_pct_2023
  FROM attendance_2023_cleaned
  GROUP BY centre_name
),
avg_2024 AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name,
    AVG(attendance_pct) AS avg_attendance_pct_2024
  FROM attendance_2024_cleaned
  GROUP BY centre_name
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(a23.centre_name, a24.centre_name) AS centre_name,
  a23.avg_attendance_pct_2023,
  a24.avg_attendance_pct_2024
FROM avg_2023 a23
FULL OUTER JOIN avg_2024 a24 ON a23.centre_name = a24.centre_name;
```
